Re: Your Rental Account at: 2016 Oak Park Lane
Decatur, GA 30032

Dear Resident(s):

Georgia law requires that we notify tenants regarding the disposition of their security deposit after they move out.
Our Records indicate that you paid a deposit of $ 0.00 on the property you leased from Excalibur.

Your current balance due is more than your Security Deposit amount. We have, therefore, applied the deposit to
outstanding charges. The remaining balance is still due as shown on the attached ledger.

 If you moved out prior to the end of your lease without the Landlord's consent then you owe rent through the end of the
 lease or until a new tenant moves in and starts paying rent. If this is your circumstance then the charges on the attached
 register show rent charged through the end of the lease. Once the property has been re-rented and we know the date that
 the new tenant starts paying rent, your charges for rent will be reduced accordingly.

 Please send in certified funds for payment in full or call to arrange a payment schedule within 30 days of the date of this
 letter. If we have not heard from you within 30 days the unpaid balance may be sent to a collection agency. This might
 have a negative impact on your credit rating.

Please contact our office as soon as possible so that we may resolve this situation.

Sincerely,

Logan White
For Excalibur Homes, LLC
loganw@excaliburhomes.com
